text:
[slide 1]
STH800G SERIES SWITCHES
DATASHEET
High Performance Data Center Switch
Product Overview
The STH800G Series switches are designed on a domestic new generation switch Chip, which is called SerdesX Series Chip platform.
With 32 x 800G high speed ports and rich features, these switches will perfectly meet the requirements of supercomputing, Data Center, and AI/ML Networks.
Key features of the STH800G Series switches
High-density 800G switch, 32*800G OSFP
Redundant hot-swappable power and fans ensure continuous stability
MPLS (label-switching-based) integrates IP flexibility and connection-oriented reliability, enabling isolated multi-service bearing, precise traffic scheduling, fast fault self-healing, and lower networking costs to meet multi-scenario efficient needs
Support VXLAN/EVPN tunnel technology, unlimited data transmission
RDMA end-to-end data forwarding, build a lossless network without packet loss
Support MLAG, cross-device link aggregation technology
The STH800G Series switches provide redundant hot-swappable power supplies (AC and DC are both available) and 4 bays with Field replaceable fan modules.
Generally, airflow of STH800G Series is front to rear (AFO), but a customization of rear to front (AFI) airflow is also acceptable.
Table 1: Feasible PSU and airflow of STH-32OC
Version: V1.2
Release Date: 2025/12/20
Items	AC	DC	AFO	AFI	Power Input	FAN
STH-32OC-HSI	◯	◯	◯	◯	2	4

[slide 2]
The STH800G Series switches support varied management ways, include console port / in-band network ports / out-of-band network port. Support SNMP v1/v2/v3, Support CLI (Command Line Interface), web management, Telnet and FTP connection. Support OAM to make management more convenient, and support SSH2.0, SSL, etc. to ensure security of management.
Moreover, leveraging its profound technical expertise and in-depth understanding of campus and enterprise networking needs, Saga Telecom has launched the Da Hu Cloud Management System (DHCS).
It enhances network management and maintenance efficiency, reduces costs, elevates management intelligence, and delivers a faster, smarter, more secure and reliable network to better meet user requirements.
